summary: Frontend-only verification of PUSH-conflict UI (Vampire's Choice Phase 5 final). Anonymous regression + full PUSH-conflict happy paths (keep-device and keep-cloud with confirm/cancel) validated end-to-end against the preview URL with a real MongoDB-seeded authenticated session. All new push-conflict test-ids render correctly, local progress is NEVER silently overwritten by cloud on 409, keep-device successfully re-pushes at the latest revision, and keep-cloud requires and honours the explicit confirm step (cancel returns to choice; confirm adopts cloud). Two screenshots captured (modal shown with 'This device · Chapter 1' + 'Cloud · Chapter 9'; final state shows 'Elena · Chapter 12' with 9012 blood coins after keep-cloud confirm).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py _now() returns an ISO string which is fine for the current happy path, but any future code path that writes a raw datetime into account_saves and later hits the 409 JSONResponse path (line 378, 394) will crash with 'Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable' because JSONResponse uses stdlib json.dumps (no jsonable_encoder). Consider wrapping the content in jsonable_encoder(...) inside _account_conflict / put_my_save 409 branches to be defensively future-proof. (Not a live bug today; only triggered by our test harness's initial datetime write, which we corrected.)
test_credentials: Ephemeral test user seeded per run via /tmp/mongo_helper.py (users + user_sessions collections). Cleaned up in finally block.
seed_data_creation: Per-run: 1 users doc, 1 user_sessions doc (7d expiry), 1 account_saves doc (created via PUT /api/me/save, then revision bumped in Mongo to simulate a 2nd device). All deleted after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local state is stored under localStorage key 'vampires_choice_player_state_v1' (NOT 'vampires_choice_state'). Sync meta is 'vc_sync_meta'. To reliably force a debounced PUSH after adopting an account save, click #audio-toggle-btn (Navbar toggleSound -> updateSettings mutates state). Screen changes (setScreen) do NOT change PlayerState and therefore push short-circuits with lastSyncedJson === json. Push-conflict modal test-ids all present and behave as spec'd. Backend rev PUT works and the anon regression is stable.
rca of the issue: N/A - all tests passed. Only intermediate test-authoring hiccups: (1) initial browser context carried stale cookies from a prior test - fixed by page.context.clear_cookies(); (2) initial trigger used setScreen which doesn't mutate PlayerState so push short-circuited - fixed by clicking #audio-toggle-btn instead; (3) mongo_helper originally wrote a native datetime into account_saves.updatedAt which broke the 409 JSONResponse (stdlib json can't serialize datetime) - fixed by writing .isoformat() strings. All three were test-side issues; the app under test behaved correctly at every step.
